=== about
A refresh with jitter still makes its request, after a random wait.
=== page
<div id="cart" ypy-get="/cart">0</div>
=== input
event: ypy-refresh
data: selector #cart
data: debounce 0
data: jitter 30

=== dom
<div id="cart" ypy-get="/cart">1</div>
=== respond
/cart => 1
=== requests
GET /cart
